Name: Dr. Dave A. Chokshi, Board of Health
Title: RESOLUTION APPROVING THE APPOINTMENT BY THE MAYOR OF DAVE CHOKSHI AS A MEMBER OF THE NEW YORK CITY BOARD OF HEALTH.
BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

History.Description: This Resolution was Approved by Committee
History.BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

Text:
RESOLVED, Pursuant to Section 31 of the New York City Charter, the Council hereby approves the appointment by the Mayor of Dave Chokshi as a member of the New York City Board of Health to serve the remainder of a six-year term that will expire on May 31, 2030.

COUPLED ON GO
